name: Namigaki Yuutarou
source:
Sex: Male
Occupation: University Student
Curse Echo: [url=/c124693]The Foot-Washing Mansion[/url]

The young man encountered at Ryogoku Bridge. He didn't hide the fact that he was a curse bearer.
[spoiler]His curse stone was later recovered by [url=/c124600]Tetsuo Tsutsumi[/url].[/spoiler]
* * *
Yutaro is an elite student at a prestigious university. He lives off the generous allowance he receives from his parents, who are both prominent local figures.
Although Yutaro has lived a charmed material life, emotional neglect at home has caused him to developed a spoiled, egotistical streak. The only kindness he knew growing up was from his family's maid, and he still fondly thinks of the plain rice with butter they used to enjoy together.

[From in-game Persons of Interest profile]

[spoiler]While trying to impress his partner, [url=/c124614]Ayame Tono[/url], Yutaro killed [url=/c124637]Michiyo Shiraishi[/url] in a hit-and-run accident. Overrun with guilt, he pursues the Rite of Resurrection to bring back Michiyo.[/spoiler]
